nl: Start tools/a.py invoice in the background, run tools/b.py invoice in the foreground meanwhile, then wait for tools/a.py. Write the output of a.py followed by the output of b.py to invoice.txt.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(1)
print(f"part A of {sys.argv[1]}")

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/a.py", "invoice"] background: true
run ["python3", "tools/b.py", "invoice"]
jobs wait: 30s |> select stdout |> write "invoice.txt"
reference_bash:
python3 tools/a.py invoice > a.out &
pid=$!
b=$(python3 tools/b.py invoice)
wait $pid
{ cat a.out; echo "$b"; } > invoice.txt
rm a.out
